native_result.query: What is the proportion of junior professors in replicated studies in Psychology?
native_result.HypoA: In Psychology, replicated studies have a much higher proportion of junior professor (64.7%) and in the original studies the senior professors are more represented (82.4%)
native_result.HypoB: About 29% (10 of 35) of the replications that succeeded in the Psychology replication project (project == 'rpp') were led by a junior professor (Assistant Professor) as most senior author, compared with 23.7% (23/97) of all attempted rpp pairs; junior-led replications were numerically more likely to succeed (28.6% of successes vs 21.0% of failures) but the association is not statistically reliable (Fisher exact OR = 1.51, p = 0.46). Broader readings of 'junior' raise the share to 45.7% (adding 'Assistant') or 65.7% (anything below full Professor), while an original-side reading (seniority.o) is 0% by construction.
native_result.WorkflowB: 1) Inspected both staged CSVs and diagnosed the mixed row units (ml1/ml3 = 786 lab rows + 26 aggregated study rows; rpp/ee = one row per original-study/replication pair). 2) Built the frame from file A only: project == 'rpp' (97 pairs, Psychology per datasets.json coding); file B used only as a non-authoritative cross-check (no seniority field). 3) Primary statistic: among rpp pairs with replicated == 1 (n=35), share with seniority.r == 'Assistant Professor' = 10/35 = 28.57% (Wilson 95% CI 16.3-45.1). 4) Ran a 36-cell sensitivity grid over junior definition (AsstProf / +Assistant / below full Professor), seniority field (.r vs degenerate .o), denominator (replicated==1 vs all 97, plus replicated==0 contrast), provider drop flag, pair-level vs unique-original-study, and an 'all psychology projects' variant using aggregated == True rows only (never lab rows). 5) Characterised drivers: listed the 10 junior-led successes with their original-paper journal, discipline, original lead rank, replication p-value/effect and relative_es; ran a Fisher exact test for junior rank x replication success. 6) Passed 12 data-quality checks (unit integrity, completeness, category hygiene, reproducibility of the replicated flag, duplicate original studies, drop flag, ml aggregation guard) and flagged the 29-of-97 undocumented rpp coverage gap relative to file B without imputation. Outputs: analysis/results/{report.txt, sensitivity_table.csv, headline_junior_pairs.csv, data_quality_checks.csv, fileB_crosscheck_matches.csv}.
